detailed_description: The Image Rounder tool applies rounded corners or a circle crop to an uploaded image in the browser. Choose an image file, enable circle mode or adjust the corner radius slider, then preview the result on a canvas. The processed image can be downloaded as a PNG. It is useful for quick avatar, thumbnail, and UI mockup preparation, but it does not provide separate X/Y radius controls, output format selection, anti-aliasing settings, or batch processing.
usage_steps: Choose an image file from your device.
Enable Circle Mode if you want a circular crop.
For rounded corners, adjust the radius slider.
Click Download PNG to save the processed image.
usage_examples: Create a circular avatar preview from a square profile image.
Round the corners of a product thumbnail before adding it to a mockup.
Prepare a PNG with softer corners for a design note.
Compare different corner radius values for a small UI asset.
